blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

(2) The one verified apartment building's build year conflicts between listings (2004 vs 2005) — see the Westbrooke entry.
Westbrooke — 12020 207A Street

Listings describe a pet-friendly building with a rentable guest suite, an elevator, storage, underground parking, and gas and hot water included in the strata fee, overlooking the McKinney Creek greenbelt. Build-year conflict: one current listing (unit 305) gives 2004, while two other current listings (units 301 and 304) give 2005 — the exact year is not confirmed, sources differ (2004/2005). Unit count: Not confirmed from the sources checked. Age restrictions: none stated in any source checked — not confirmed either way until the registered bylaws are read on the Form B.
Streets, schools and getting around Northwest Maple Ridge

items.t: Where the condo stock concentrates: a single verified apartment building on 207A Street — Westbrooke at 12020 207A Street — plus one townhome complex on the same street (The Meadows, 12070 207A Street).
SD42 has no middle tier (K–7 / 8–12) and catchments are address-based; catchment for any specific Northwest address is not verified without a locator run.

Transit: Maple Meadows Station serves the city's west side on the West Coast Express (weekday trains between Waterfront and Mission City), Port Haney Station is at 22300 River Road, and Haney Place Exchange carries the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Northwest Maple Ridge

items.t: ALR stratification bar and housing frame: ALR status is per-parcel — check the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping for any specific lot. On ALR parcels, residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)), and the ALC housing frame is one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha).

blocks.text: Good to know about Northwest Maple Ridge

items.t: The Lougheed Transit Corridor Plan was adopted on January 27, 2026 — Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted at that meeting, after a January 20, 2026 public hearing (City news release February 4, 2026). The corridor ends at 221 Street, so Westbrooke's 207A Street ground sits inside the corridor's west end — the adopted plan, not today's one-building stock, is the supply story for this sub-area.

One street carries the whole verified strata stock: Westbrooke (apartments) and The Meadows (townhomes, 1988) both stand on 207A Street, 50 civic numbers apart — a buyer comparing "condo vs townhome" in Northwest is, in practice, comparing two complexes on one street.

The page's dividing line is a framing, not a confirmed boundary: the claim that the sub-area splits sharply at Abernethy Way / 128 Avenue — serviced RS-1 south, ALR floodplain north — was not confirmed on a City OCP or servicing document pass; the zone minimums are real, the line itself is not verified. Price a parcel on its own zone, ALR and floodplain checks.

A second address shadows the one verified building: a building directory carries a separate record for 12025 207A Street, across from Westbrooke's 12020 address — whether it is a second phase or a distinct complex is not confirmed, so searches under only one address can miss units.

The City of Maple Ridge doesn't publish a boundary for it," and its feed cards carry the "Northwest Maple Ridge" label.
Nearby: Southwest (Hammond / Port Hammond), West Central and Town Centre, Pitt Meadows across the western boundary.
Maple Ridge community medians (not Northwest figures): detached $1,131,000; attached $525,000.
SD42 has no middle tier (K–7 / 8–12).

Transit: Maple Meadows Station serves the west side on the West Coast Express (weekday Waterfront–Mission City); Port Haney Station is at 22300 River Road. TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning (22 km, peak service every 10 minutes; designs/costs/timelines not yet determined).

Floodplain and care: Fraser River flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic (incl. freeboard); no habitable floor space below it on affected lots; suites prohibited on floodplain properties (Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h)). Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital.

items.t: Form B diligence (Westbrooke today; The Meadows if verified and counted): SPA s. 59 — fees, amounts owing, special levies, CRF balance, insurance, rules, budget, Rental Disclosure Statement, depreciation report; within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢ per page.

Maple Ridge zoning and plans: Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 — RS-1 subdivision minimums 668.0 m² / 18.0 m / 27.0 m, max coverage 40%; rural zones A-1 2.0 ha, A-2 4.0 ha, A-3 8.0 ha, RS-2 0.4 ha, RS-3 0.8 or 2.0 ha. OCP citation contested (7060-2014 vs 7998-2024) — flagged, resolved nowhere. Lougheed Transit Corridor adopted Jan 27, 2026 per City record (OCP Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021; corridor western boundary to 221 Street along Lougheed Hwy / Dewdney Trunk Rd, covering this sub-area's south edge).

Suites / SSMUH / flood / ALR: one secondary suite per lot inside the house, max 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain; eligible lots may reach 3, 4 or 6 units under SSMUH bylaws on non-ALR lots. Flood construction level 6.7 m; suites prohibited on floodplain properties (s. 402.8(h)). ALR: one principal residence max 500 m² plus at most one additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha); residences cannot be stratified.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 7 condos and townhomes listed in Northwest. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Northwest?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in Northwest had a sales ratio of 14% on only 7 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is Northwest a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: 9 condos and townhomes sold in Northwest over those 5 months, out of 230 in all of Maple Ridge.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Northwest from June to October 2026?

faq.a: One verified: Westbrooke at 12020 207A Street, an apartment building classified Apartment/Condo in current listings.
faq.q: How many condo buildings are there in Northwest Maple Ridge?

faq.a: Sources conflict: one current listing gives 2004 and two others give 2005. Treat the year as not confirmed (2004/2005) until the strata plan or Form B settles it; the building is mid-2000s either way.

Current listings describe it as a pet-friendly building — that is listing-level description, and pet bylaws can carry size/number limits, so confirm the registered bylaw wording on the Form B package before buying with a pet.

One current listing states gas and hot water are included, and describes a rentable guest suite, elevator and underground parking among the building's features. Exact inclusions are stated on the Form B — read them there, not from a listing summary.
faq.q: What does the Westbrooke strata fee cover?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. A short-term rental bylaw can still bind you; check the registered bylaws regardless.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Westbrooke unit long-term?

faq.a: In character, on listing evidence, yes — a 1988 complex at 12070 207A Street whose listing records a strata fee, with a directory summary of pets allowed with restrictions and rentals allowed with restrictions (rental part void since Nov 24, 2022). Proceed with full Form B diligence.
faq.q: Is The Meadows a strata townhouse I can buy into?

faq.a: Not confirmed (2004/2005) — listings conflict; the strata plan or Form B settles it.
